verdict.rationale: Kit's developer docs have a dedicated webhooks section. Integrations can react to account activity as it happens instead of polling, every delivery is signed with the endpoint's secret, and failed deliveries are retried with backoff up to 8 attempts. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of subscribable event types, evidence of how webhooks are registered or managed (e.g., API endpoint or UI), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
